Definition: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hezekiah or Hizkiah or Hizkijah = "Jehovah is my strength"; 1) 12th king of Judah, son of Ahaz and Abijah; a good king in that he served Jehovah and did away with idolatrous practices; 2) great-great-grandfather of Zephaniah the prophet; 3) son of Neariah, a descendant of David; 4) head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah
